testCases.label: Verify create_list returns a sequential list for positive input
testCases.description: Checks that create_list(5) returns the list [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].

testCases.label: Verify create_list raises ValueError for zero
testCases.description: Ensures create_list(0) raises a ValueError with the message 'Number of elements must be positive'.

testCases.label: Verify create_list raises ValueError for negative input
testCases.description: Ensures create_list(-5) raises a ValueError with the message 'Number of elements must be positive'.

testCases.label: Verify modify_list updates the list correctly
testCases.description: Checks that modify_list appends, inserts, and removes values appropriately, transforming [1,2,3,4,5] into [0,1,2,4,5,6].

testCases.label: Verify slice_list returns expected slices
testCases.description: Ensures slice_list returns [1,2,3] with default parameters, and [2,3,4] when using start=1 and end=4.
